name: fp6_liger_rmsnorm_relative_error_near_zero
kernel_family: Liger-Kernel RMSNorm, correct kernel at two precisions
mechanism: The real, correct RMSNorm kernel run on an FP32 input and the same real kernel run on a BF16-rounded copy of that input are both correct for their declared precision. On an input row close to (but not exactly) zero, the true output is extremely small, so an ordinary BF16 rounding difference of the input becomes a large relative error in the output even though the absolute difference is negligible -- an artifact of the comparison metric, not a kernel defect.

expected.ground_truth: both kernel invocations are the real, correct kernel; the discrepancy is ordinary BF16 rounding of the input

note: Uses the real, unmodified Liger RMSNorm kernel (same kernel as fn7's reference) at two input precisions. Runs on GPU.
